project.title: From sewage sludge to high-value carboxylic acids: acidogenic fermentation with ethanol, lactic acid and agro-industrial residues
project.description: - Ethanol added to sewage sludge-derived HTC process water promoted caproate;- Lactic acid addition to process water increased propionate accumulation;- High electron donor-to-acceptor molar ratios markedly decreased caproate production;- Ethanol addition via wine lees to process water increased caproate production;- Cheese whey addition to process water promoted butyrate and caproate accumulation;
